clues.text: In John's vision, a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, wore one of twelve stars.
At his feast, King Xerxes sent for Queen Vashti to come wearing her royal one and show her beauty.
After Rabbah fell, David took this from the Ammonite king's head. It weighed a talent of gold.
Jehoiada the priest brought out the king's son, put this on him, and the people shouted, 'Long live the king!'
An Amalekite came to David carrying this, taken from the fallen Saul's head, along with the band from his arm.
James wrote that the man who perseveres under trial will receive this 'of life' that God has promised.
Near the end of his race, Paul wrote that one 'of righteousness' was laid up for him by the righteous Judge.
